title: The Containership Revolution
lineage: Inspected the cited passage; retained file is a paraphrased research note, not the original source.

passages.note: On 26 April 1956 Ideal X left Port Newark with 58 detached trailer bodies for Houston; they were fitted to running gear at destination. Gateway City in 1957 used racks and stacks; 1956 tankers lacked this later design.
